summary.text: Amanda Hemmingsen-Jaeger is a Democratic state senator who has represented Minnesota Senate District 47 since November 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She previously served in the Minnesota House from 2023 to 2025 and worked as a policy analyst and forensic scientist for the State of Minnesota.

paragraphs.text: Amanda Hemmingsen-Jaeger lives in Woodbury, Minnesota.
She earned a master's degree in genetics from Iowa State University in 2008 and a master's degree in science, technology and environmental policy from the University of Minnesota in 2016.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as working as a legislative and policy analyst, business and management analyst, and forensic scientist for the State of Minnesota.

Hemmingsen-Jaeger joined the Minnesota Association of Professional Employees union in 2011 and in 2021 began serving on the Metro Transit Gold Line Bus Rapid Transit Community and Business Advisory Committee and the Woodbury for Justice and Equality city government committee.
She represented House District 47A from 2023 to 2025, succeeding Jim Nash, and took office in the Senate on November 18, 2025, succeeding Nicole Mitchell.
